title: Notting Hill Large Residential Mortgage
h1: Not revealed by search results (result link title is 'Notting Hill Large Residential Mortgage'; H1 not independently confirmed)
summary: Case study of a large residential mortgage refinance on a property in Notting Hill, London. Borrower: an Egyptian client whose income came from the oil and gas sector (a sector most European private banks treat as high risk), who lived in a high-risk country and had little cash on hand. The property was held in an offshore trust. Silver Oak Capital placed the loan with a Middle East-based private bank experienced with offshore trust structures. Terms: £6.35 million loan, 60% loan-to-value, interest-only, five-year term, priced at base rate plus 1.50% margin, with a 0.50% fee. Timing: the search tool reported the page metadata as posted about 231 days before 2026-10-29 (approximately March 2026). Challenge: sector/country risk profile rejected or priced as high risk by European private banks, plus low liquidity and an offshore trust ownership structure. Outcome: five-year interest-only private bank facility agreed at 60% LTV.
